newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil November exports expected Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil November exports expected Tuesday.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce expects to announce exports for November on Tuesday, a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said no time had yet been set for the publication of the export figures but it was likely to be in the afternoon, local time.
Up to the end of the third week of the month, exports had totalled $2.944 billion with a daily average of $196.3.
In October, Brazil posted a record $1.3 billion deficit on exports of $4.188 billion and imports of $5.496 billion.
